### 2026-10-11 – Entry 2 -

**3h**

Entry 2 -

I added the proper footprints and did a really stupid mistake. I somehow deleted the KiCad inbuilt footprints and it took me like 20 minutes to figure that out which was kinda stupid.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tpvKcXzg1BqDtyxLqEIieRzA6AtJ3aEo/2a1abda22a41ed403bc368f8c5b9a9d83413540c8c4f88bd36d990472d22b548.png)
(Thankfully it works now i reset the footprint files)

After that was resolved I started with the PCB and wiring.
The wiring was a pain, god that was horrible.
I didn't realize you could have copper pathways cross eachother by making one go through the bottom. I spent too much time trying to find a way to make all the pathways connect on just one layer. Thankfully I realized later after checking the guide again and figuring out what the blue lines were. It made the routing so much earlier.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tpvKcXzg1BqDtyxLqEIieRzA6AtJ3aEo/bc2df42106c540db4bfd58a9d3e58d87d4069d9bd62bc1ba94f26e971afc81f3.png)
(It used to look so messy and didn't route properly)

As you can see, I also added some images to customize my PCB.
We have:
The fool emblem
Bongo cat
Flareon (the best eeveelution he so floofy :D)

It took a while to figure out how to get those guys in there, but thankfully it worked out at the end
And now I have these cool footprints I can add to projects :D

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/tpvKcXzg1BqDtyxLqEIieRzA6AtJ3aEo/4dad02794a01eb9307be29fc23617344ed2350fcae2dee576e78c0f5d32bec6c.png)
